title: CSAF Godot Collection: 24 Addon Packs for Godot 4
shortText: All 24 CSAF Godot 4 addons in one project. 1,273 presets, new packs added free.
html:
The CSAF Godot Collection puts all 24 of our paid Godot 4.7 addon packs in one project: 1,273 presets for 2D games, royalty free. New packs join it free on the day they launch. Try 132 of the presets first in the free sampler.

Press Play and a browser opens every pack's demo. Then walk through The World: one town at dusk with 18 of the addons running at once, each through the calls its Readme shows.

What is inside

  • Combat and magic: Emberflux (120 effects), Sigil Core (60 magic circles), Warhost army battles
  • Weather, water, light: Weatherglass, Tidewater, Lantern
  • Shadow, sight, fog: Gnomon sprite shadows, Glimpse occlusion, Fogbank fog of war
  • Your art, changed: Smithereens breakables, Verdigris ageing, Wrack ruin on your tiles, Scathe battle damage, Threshold door openings, Timber trees that fall
  • Life: Vivarium small creatures, Fathom sea life and underwater levels, Kickup footstep dust, Township NPC routines
  • Things players keep: Cartography journey maps, Arras tapestries, Broadsheet notices and coins, Augury tarot, Jigsaw puzzles

Every preset is computed at runtime by shaders, particles or _draw() code. Copy one addon or all of them: none depends on another.

The price

Singly these packs list at $9.99 to $14.99 each. If you want three, this page already costs less, and the packs added later come with it.

Both renderers

Every preset is photographed under Forward+ and Compatibility, the web renderer, in this one project. Built and tested on Godot 4.7.2; older versions were not run.

One measured limit: under Compatibility, 64 Cartography and Fogbank scenes alive at once crashed the engine; 56 ran clean, and Forward+ ran 96.

Install

Open the godot folder as a project and press Play. To use an addon, copy addons/<name> into your project. Each pack's own Readme and licence are in docs/<name>. Read the docs.

New packs

New CSAF Godot packs join this download on launch day, at no extra cost. No promise is made about how many or how often.

Licence

Royalty free in your games, no credit required. No resale or redistribution of the files as a pack.

Made with AI tools: the code was written with AI, the demo art comes from our own generated sets, and the cover is a generated illustration.

More from the same studio

  • CSAF Godot 4 Sampler, 132 free presets from 11 of these addons.
  • Verdant 09 Town, the town in The World as a full tileset.
